rationale: The workflow is a documentation pipeline (Writerside build -> test -> robots.txt -> GitHub Pages deploy) with no package-manager dependency-install step or lockfile, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency download caching) has nothing safe to cache; its evidence requires repeated dependency fetching with lockfile/environment inputs. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because the workflow includes a deployment job (deploy-pages to a GitHub Pages environment). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST does not apply because there are no matrix jobs. Test selection/prioritization and custom timeouts are not supported: there is no test suite to select or reorder, and there is no representative duration history to set a safe job timeout. Applying any of these would either be unsupported by the workflow structure or risk weakening required build/test/deploy coverage.
